## [FX-IT25-202-SLABS] Section 202 — New regime slab rates (Tax Year 2026-27)
section: 202
effective_from: 2026-04-01
effective_to:
topic: slabs
verified: yes

Under section 202 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, for Tax Year 2026-27 the new tax regime slab rates are: income up to 4 lakh is nil, 4 to 8 lakh is taxed at 5 percent, 8 to 12 lakh at 10 percent, 12 to 16 lakh at 15 percent, 16 to 20 lakh at 20 percent, 20 to 24 lakh at 25 percent and above 24 lakh at 30 percent. Salaried people get a standard deduction of 75,000 rupees.

## [FX-IT25-156-REBATE] Section 156 — Rebate for income up to 12 lakh (Tax Year 2026-27)
section: 156
effective_from: 2026-04-01
effective_to:
topic: rebate
verified: yes

Section 156 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 gives a rebate of up to 60,000 rupees to a resident individual in the new regime whose total income does not exceed 12 lakh rupees in Tax Year 2026-27. This means salaried people earning up to 12.75 lakh pay no tax after the standard deduction. Marginal relief applies just above 12 lakh.
